lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters posterior to the gills, organized into roughly three horizontal rows and vertical columns.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersecting with horizontal ridges to form a matrix of anchor nodes for the primary spots.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Distinct horizontal ridges running along the upper flank with a sharp vertical gradient from light to shadow.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced density of small, bright spots on the visible surface of the pectoral fin in the lower portion of the frame.
